memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil." — Ephesians 5:16

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
​“Redemption” means “to buy back, to rescue, or to protect.” Just as Jesus redeemed us from sin, we are called to redeem our time—protecting it from being wasted and from slipping into evil.
​If we lack wisdom, the allurements of this world will completely consume and drain our time. Satan delights in watching every single minute of ours spent in vain.
​However, a wise person values time. They awake, live with self-control, and walk in diligence. Redeeming the time is not merely an achievement of intellect; it is the primary duty of a spiritual person.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: ​“You may delay, but time will not.” — Benjamin Franklin

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: ​"Lord, teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom. Help me to live every single hour for You, and keep me far from evil and the traps of the adversary. I dedicate my time completely to You. Amen."

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May your time be redeemed for eternity. May your every minute be filled with divine purpose.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: THE PURSUIT OF GOD
recommended_book.author: A.W. Tozer
recommended_book.quote: He who desires to know God must set apart time for God.”
